description: A cardboard box sits on the left side of the desk, with a pile of clothes in the middle and a small stand holding a book and a white cup on the right. The left hand lifts and holds the cardboard box closer while the right hand repeatedly reaches rightward to gather items, stuffing a dark garment and then a light shirt into the box, then placing the book and the cup on top before the left hand shifts the box slightly to the right.
